draft.subject: Next step after your Cedar Logistics onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. You've got your first project in Wrenfield and an invite out, which is a good start.

The next step that usually makes things click is getting real work into that project -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If a teammate hasn't accepted yet, an admin can resend an invite from Account Settings.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that came up after we spoke.

Best,
Chidi
